title: Record evidence where it can be found again
when: A recipe, help text or refusal is wrong or missing, or a bug sits outside the task
need: File each distinct wrong or missing recipe or outside-scope defect. Link repeats to the first note id; durable correlation keeps them under one root. Append deduplicates normalized 200-character prefixes for 24 hours per project/author and caps sessions at ten distinct roots, with a warning at eight. Correlated evidence remains available; unrelated excess findings go to the item Progress Log for operator review.
surface: Generated AGENTS/skill directive -> field-note append help; public Ouroboros page.
